description: TypeScript source file defining types, interfaces, and constants for Playwright core client, including options for browser contexts, timeouts, events, and external channel references.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Interface for logging with methods to check if enabled and to log messages.

classes.name: ClientCertificate
classes.description: Type representing client SSL certificates and related credentials.

classes.name: BrowserContextOptions
classes.description: Options for configuring a browser context, including viewport, headers, storage, and recording options.

classes.name: LaunchOverrides
classes.description: Additional options for launching browsers, including environment variables and timeouts.

classes.name: LaunchOptions
classes.description: Options for launching a browser, combining channel-specific options with overrides.

classes.name: LaunchPersistentContextOptions
classes.description: Options for launching a persistent browser context, extending LaunchOptions.

classes.name: ConnectOptions
classes.description: Options for connecting to a browser via WebSocket, including headers, network exposure, and logging.

classes.name: LaunchServerOptions
classes.description: Options for launching a browser server, including host, port, and WebSocket path.

classes.name: LaunchAndroidServerOptions
classes.description: Options for launching an Android server, including device serial, ADB host/port, and driver installation.

classes.name: SelectorEngine
classes.description: Interface for querying DOM elements with methods for querying single or multiple elements.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a logger is enabled for a given name and severity.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified severity, name, and optional hints.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Returns the first DOM element matching a selector within a root element.

methods.name: queryAll
methods.description: Returns all DOM elements matching a selector within a root element.
